user_prompt: We need to pull together a comprehensive view of our production risks and costs right now - I want to see both our material expenses broken down by supplier along with any compliance gaps, and at the same time analyze our recent safety incidents and trends across all our manufacturing sites. Can you get me both of those datasets so we can address cost optimization and safety improvements in our next operations review?

steps.step_name: Pull material expenses broken down by supplier to support cost optimization analysis
Identify and report on compliance gaps across our production operations
Analyze recent safety incidents and trends across all manufacturing sites
